schematics.author: JMAO01, LotoEU99
schematics.description: A large automatic cactus farm built on a 4 by 4 chunk footprint, roughly 90 blocks wide, 90 deep and 176 high, with a water-fed grid of sand and cactus channels and a hidden central area. Its walls and frame are white stained glass with oak and spruce fence gates, and the tall outer structure is mostly cactus and sand with about 155,000 blocks total. The source gives a rate of about 50,000 cactus per hour, and it contains no block entities such as chests or hoppers.

schematics.author: b333nja
schematics.description: A medieval-style house built mostly from spruce slabs, stairs and stripped spruce logs, with stone, andesite, tuff and deepslate brick walls and dark oak planks. It is about 32 wide, 34 high and 26 deep, with a stepped roofline. The interior is furnished with chests, barrels, beds, a furnace, a blast furnace, a brewing stand, a bell, banners, a jukebox and other utility blocks.

schematics.author: Bear_
schematics.description: A large A-frame build with a 66 by 66 block footprint and a height of 28 blocks, sitting on a thick stone and dirt base. Its peaked dark oak and gray terracotta gables are dusted with snow, with black stained glass windows and a light gray carpet interior. Inside are a beacon, furnaces, hoppers, signs, flower pots and skulls, so it reads as a lodge or a base rather than an empty shell.

schematics.author: Luubox
schematics.description: A large symmetrical mansion built on a raised grassy hill, remaking the author's earlier House on a Hill. It uses oak planks, stone, cobblestone, and glass, with a sand-and-stone courtyard layout and tall pitched roofs. At roughly 37 by 19 by 27 blocks, it is a sizeable mansion-style home; the interior has bookshelves, chests, a furnace, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: RezolutnyDarek
schematics.description: A large baroque palace built mostly from stone bricks, sandstone and white wool, with a grand symmetrical front, tall blocky towers at the corners and a central block with a courtyard visible from above. It is roughly 212 blocks wide, 57 high and 161 deep, a very big structure with around 155,000 blocks, and it includes bookshelves, iron bars, glass panes and gold block accents with a sign inside.

schematics.author: vinyl-ripp

title.es: Castillo de piedra cubierto de musgo
title.pt: Castelo de pedra coberto de musgo

schematics.description: A large stone castle built mostly from stone bricks with mossy stone, cobblestone, and dirt, softened by oak leaves, vines, and grass for an overgrown look. It measures about 31 wide, 49 high, and 30 deep blocks, with a small water feature, red wool accents, and nether brick fences as detail. No interior blocks or block entities are listed, so it appears to be an exterior-only build.

schematics.author: Creator409
schematics.description: A floating fortress built almost entirely from snow blocks and stone slabs, with iron block walls, ice accents, black wool trim, and glass windows, rising into a snowy sky over a water basin. It is very large, about 207 wide by 128 high by 190 deep, with roughly 124,000 blocks, and its interior holds a chest, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: Goldeneye33
schematics.description: A large colonial-style mansion built from quartz, stone brick, and bricks, with a green-wool roof, pillared facade, and a surrounding grassy and podzol garden with a pond. Measuring about 82 blocks wide, 32 high, and 125 deep, it is a big estate-scale build. The interior is furnished with chests, furnaces, a beacon, cauldrons, flower pots, and a record player.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A solid 17×17×17 cube built mostly from glass and stone, with dirt, sand, grass, black wool, a water layer and several ore blocks. The front and top views are fully filled, so it reads as one closed block rather than an open structure. Inside it holds chests, a mob spawner and signs, and it is a survival map built around a cube shape.

schematics.author: Gigorahk
schematics.description: A huge, free-standing tree built mostly from jungle leaves wrapped around a thick trunk and branches of oak logs, with a small dirt base. It is very large, about 82 blocks wide, 77 high and 72 deep, made of roughly 27,000 blocks, and it has no interior or block entities to explore.

schematics.author: TingyBangy
schematics.description: A large French country chateau with a tall roof, white wool walls, and stone brick and sandstone trim, set among trees and gardens. It spans about 63 by 66 blocks and rises 26 blocks high, built from roughly 23,000 blocks. The interior includes block entities such as furnaces, hoppers, cauldrons, a beacon, and signs.

schematics.author: ImperiumMC
schematics.description: A large medieval-style house built mostly from gray terracotta walls, spruce logs, and spruce slabs, with snow blocks and grass roofing giving it a snowy, mossy look. It measures about 38 wide, 30 high, and 23 deep, using roughly 3,400 blocks. The source has no description, and no block entities or interior details are listed, so the inside is unknown.

schematics.author: Venom
schematics.description: A modern house built mostly from quartz slabs and blocks, with glass panes, spruce and birch planks, and stone slabs, set in a grassy landscape with oak and jungle leaves, dandelions, poppies, and a small water feature. It spans about 74 wide, 25 high, and 65 deep, with roughly 15,400 blocks. The source has no written description, so the interior layout is not documented.

schematics.author: Milsdar
schematics.description: A medieval-style build made mostly of stone bricks, mossy stone bricks, cobblestone, and oak planks, with oak logs and fences, and blue wool accents. It is roughly 53 by 49 by 115 blocks, about 60,700 blocks in total, and is spread out along its long depth. The interior includes a record player and signs.

schematics.author: 3RYCK
schematics.description: A large sandstone-and-oak mansion with stone brick trim, a grassy courtyard with dirt paths, and a tall stepped roof section with a central spire-like tower in spruce and oak. The build is about 56 wide, 29 high and 73 deep, with around 16,900 blocks. Inside are bookshelves, an enchanting table, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player, chests and signs, and a small pond with water and flowers in the grounds.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large symmetrical mansion built mostly from sandstone, quartz, and stone bricks, with spruce wood accents, black glass panes, and water features set among grass lawns. It measures about 169 wide, 38 high, and 142 deep, and the source includes a beacon and signs as block entities, suggesting a furnished interior.

schematics.author: Z3N0N
schematics.description: A large mansion built mainly from sandstone, jungle planks, and stone, with glass windows, iron bars, and glowstone lighting, set on a dirt and grass base with some water. It measures 88 wide, 34 high, and 72 deep, about 54,000 blocks. Inside are chests, furnaces, a cauldron, signs, a record player, and music blocks.

schematics.author: flaminsnowman99
schematics.description: A large oak-and-wool manor house with a tall pitched roof, glass windows, and a stone-slab base, set among oak trees with a small water feature and wheat plots nearby. It is roughly 61 wide, 18 high, and 73 deep, with no interior blocks or block entities recorded, so it reads as an exterior-only build. The description is inferred from the block list and layout map, not from the author's notes, which were empty.

schematics.author: Madnes64
schematics.description: A large medieval cathedral built mostly from stone bricks, stone brick stairs and slabs, with a tall central spire and a long nave rising from a wide flared base. Spruce and dark oak accents, red and gray wool, and blue and black stained glass windows add color and detail to the walls. At about 53 wide, 77 high and 75 deep, it is a massive landmark, with a sign as its only block entity and no interior furnishings listed.

schematics.author: Darkcrafter31
schematics.description: A medieval-style inn built from brick, oak planks, and stone slabs, with a grassy dirt base and a large sloped roof. It is about 44 by 23 by 36 blocks and contains a few chests, a furnace, and signs inside. The source gives no description, so the look is taken from the materials and layout.

schematics.author: Templario1408
schematics.description: A tall, narrow medieval watchtower built mostly from oak planks, oak logs, and stone bricks, with a stone base and wooden upper floors that step out into a wide overhanging top. It stands about 41 blocks high and 15 by 15 blocks across at its widest, with a ladder climb and a few small storage and sign details inside. The source gives no description, so this is based only on the block list and layout.

schematics.author: TingyBangy
schematics.description: A large Mediterranean-style mansion built mostly from sandstone, smooth sandstone, quartz, stone and brick, with spruce accents, green wool and sand around the grounds. It is about 63 wide, 32 high and 150 deep, roughly 60,000 blocks, with water features and snow blocks in the surroundings. The interior includes furnaces, hoppers, signs, a beacon, a record player and other functional block entities.

schematics.author: TheBello123
schematics.description: A medieval-style house built mostly from dirt, stone, spruce, and oak, with gray terracotta and snow accents and black glass pane windows. It measures about 30 by 30 blocks across and 33 deep, using roughly 7,300 blocks. The source does not describe any interior features.

schematics.author: RaptorAnka
schematics.description: A large modern house built mainly from stone, with black and white wool accents, sandstone, glass walls, and birch plank details, with some water around it. It is about 46 blocks wide and deep and 34 blocks tall, and the data shows only a sign inside, so the interior is not documented.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, white wool, glass panes and oak, jungle and birch planks, with sandstone and stone brick accents. It spans about 102 by 99 blocks and rises roughly 30 blocks high, with a mix of flat and stepped rooflines and a sandy, grassy, partly watery surrounding terrain. Interior features include chests, an enchanting table, a record player, a cauldron, signs, an ender chest and trapped chests.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, snow blocks and birch and spruce planks, with sandstone and light gray wool accents. It is about 97 blocks wide, 25 high and 77 deep, with a sprawling multi-level footprint, glass pane windows, and a snowy-and-sandy terrain base. Interior contains chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, a record player, cauldron and trapped chest among other block entities.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, sandstone and white wool, with oak leaves and birch accents, set in a grassy landscape with sand, gravel and a water feature. It measures 72 by 26 by 59 blocks and uses about 28,000 blocks. The interior includes chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, a cauldron, a record player, music blocks and signs.

schematics.author: Rolofolo
schematics.description: A modern suburban neighborhood built with dirt, snow blocks and gray wool, featuring stone brick houses, glass windows, oak accents and glowstone lighting. It spans about 43 by 27 by 29 blocks and contains a beacon and signs, with a snow-covered ground and a few houses set around a central open area.

schematics.author: Z3N0N

title.es: Villa moderna con acentos de arenisca
title.pt: Villa moderna com detalhes de arenito

schematics.description: A small modern villa built from sandstone, stone slabs, spruce and oak planks, with glass panes, iron bars and glowstone lighting. It is 37 wide, 20 high and 33 deep, roughly 10,000 blocks, with a flat multi-level roof and a grassy, dirt-based lot around it. Inside it has chests, a furnace, a record player and signs, and the build was made for a Keralis server.

schematics.author: ATalkingRock

title.es: Casa moderna blanca en la playa

schematics.description: A modern two-storey beach house with a white snow-block exterior, birch plank accents, and stone brick stairs and walls, set on a grassy lot beside a sandy shore and water. It measures about 66 blocks wide, 56 deep, and 25 high, built from roughly 14,000 blocks. Inside there is a furnace, and glowstone provides lighting; the source has no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: Leefield
schematics.description: A large farm build, about 54 blocks wide, 16 high and 64 deep, made mostly of grass blocks, sandstone, cobblestone and oak, with some spruce and oak leaves for trees and dandelion and poppy flowers as decoration. Its grassy fields are framed by stepped sandstone and stone block edges, and it contains a few chests, a furnace and signs. The source has no written description, so the layout details here come only from the block data.

schematics.author: Emily_2010
schematics.description: A two-story Victorian-style house with a steep cyan wool roof, oak plank and stone brick walls, and a tall pointed tower on one side. It measures about 33 blocks wide, 24 high and 30 deep, built from roughly 5,500 blocks, mostly dirt and grass for the grounds. The interior is not described, though the build includes a sign and a few glowstone lights.

schematics.author: Allay
schematics.description: A small starter hut with oak plank walls, a cobblestone floor, a doorway, a single glass window, and a slab roof. It is a plain 5×5×5 block box with no interior furnishings or block entities. It is a catalog sample for testing the index rather than a finished showcase build.
